messages:
lara: Quick heads-up: onboarding sampleapp returned mixed embedding dims in a single /embeddings response (512 vs 256). Repro when forcing token expiry mid-batch.
tom: which SDK/language?
lara: go-sdk sampleapp, net/http client with keep-alive pool. Batch size=6, expire token ~40ms in; retry path sometimes yields one short vector.
jin: sounds like socket carryover during retry -> leftover bytes parsed into new response. We saw axios/urllib3 issues before.
lara: raw dims-only snippet: {"data":[{"id":0,"len":512},{"id":1,"len":256},{"id":2,"len":512}],"model":"redwood-embed-1"}
tom: short-term: add strict shape validation in SDK (error if any embedding.len != expected). Also ensure response body is fully drained or close connection before reusing on retry.
jin: created go-sdk PR draft: go-sdk#189 - EmbeddingShapeGuard + on-retry connection teardown. Also added a telemetry event "mixed_embedding_size".
infra-bot: filed runtime issue RT-10321: validate embedding lengths per-response and return diagnostic on mismatch.
lara: patched sampleapp to call resp.Body.Close() and disable keepalive on retried request; local e2e 200 runs forcing expiry -> before 5 failures, after 0 silent mismatches (shape guard surfaced 5 errors).
tom: docs: add troubleshooting blurb for onboarding users explaining mixed-dim symptom and SDK upgrade recommendation. jin: will add note and link to go-sdk PR.
ci-bot: CI queued for go-sdk/shape-guard (#189) job 11012
lara: will follow up with minimal repro script in #devex. Thanks all :thumbsup:
